'''Trisjon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moorjhoni]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorjhone]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. His granddaughter [[Jatenne]] called him over when she thought that [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who had just arrived on Moorjhoni, were the "Demon in the Light" from his [[Day of Three Suns]] prophecy. After Maul was injured in a duel against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]], [[Judd]], and [[Salmara]], he made his way into the desert and was found by a group of Moorjhoni. They brought Maul to Trisjon's tent, who then explained the prophecy of the Day of Three Suns, and Maul's role as the "Demon in the Light". When Trisjon asked to speak to Maul privately about his direction of the people of Moorjhone in the [[Battle of Moorjhone|attack]] on [[Ja'Boag]]'s mine, he sensed the darkness in Maul, who then [[Telekinesis/Legends|used]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to aggravate Trisjon's heart, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.
